item.title: Americans stuck in Middle East speak out amid strikes: 'Beyond scared'
item.description: Three dozen people, including a woman from Missouri, touring Israel together. A 17-year-old, her father, and their members of their North Carolina church. A husband and wife from Pittsburgh. They're all among the unknown number of Americans who found themselves stranded in the Middle East this weekend.

item.title: Nine hospitalized after mass shooting at Cincinnati concert venue
item.description: At least nine people were hospitalized after a shooting at a Cincinnati, Ohio, nightclub and concert venue early Sunday morning.

item.title: 318 Restaurant Week 2026 kicks off in Shreveport-Bossier
item.description: Shreveport-Bossier is celebrating the 10th anniversary of 318 Restaurant Week from March 1-7, 2026, with a variety of immersive dining experiences featuring the region's talented chefs and innovative cuisine.

item.title: LSU plans to display Ten Commandments in classrooms
item.description: LSU President Wade Rousse announced that the university will comply with state law and display the Ten Commandments in its classrooms, citing a 2024 bill that requires the state to post the Ten Commandments in every K-12 and college classrooms.

item.title: Caddo Parish schools adjust schedules amid water main break
item.description: Caddo Parish Schools announced that all schools south of Northwood High School will transition to virtual instruction on March 2, 2026, due to a reported water main break, while schools in Northern Caddo Parish will remain open on their normal schedules.
